name: Adjective agreement in fixed day-part greetings
definition: In the fixed greetings «Доброе утро!», «Добрый день!» and «Добрый вечер!», the adjective agrees with the noun. Утро is neuter singular and takes доброе; день and вечер are masculine singular and take добрый. Learn each complete phrase. «До свидания!» is a separate fixed farewell, not an example of this adjective pattern.

name: Present-time identification without an overt copula
definition: For the taught present-time object-identification pattern, put это before a singular naming noun in the nominative. A separate equivalent of English 'is' is normally omitted. Это remains unchanged with the masculine and feminine nouns in this pack. This rule concerns the introductory это of identification sentences, not demonstratives used directly to modify a noun.

name: Written yes-or-no questions and one-word answers
definition: In the taught positive identification pattern, keep statement word order and replace the final full stop with a question mark: «Это ручка?» Answer «Да.» when the explicitly supplied object identity matches, or «Нет.» when it does not. This lesson addresses written questions, not spoken question intonation. Нет is taught only as an answer, not as a construction meaning 'there is no'.
